comment: Every NotSupported case in a committed baseline must match one entry (fnmatch pattern; the first match counts). scripts/docs/generate.py fails otherwise. 'kind' is 'extension' (a group for an extension or optional capability WineMetalGL does not offer), 'version' (the case needs a newer GL version than the context) or 'test-design' (the CTS reports NotSupported for this combination on every implementation; the reason cites the test code).

entries.reason: The case uses compute shaders (GL 4.3, GL_ARB_compute_shader), which are not advertised.
The case needs GL_MAX_IMAGE_SAMPLES of 4 or more. WineMetalGL reports 0, the GL minimum: Metal shaders cannot write multisample textures.
The case needs GL_MAX_IMAGE_SAMPLES of 4 or more. WineMetalGL reports 0, the GL minimum: Metal shaders cannot write multisample textures.
Without `#extension GL_EXT_shader_integer_mix` the case needs GLSL 4.50 (glcShaderIntegerMixTests.cpp, ShaderIntegerMixPrototypesCase).
The case applies only to OpenGL ES contexts and reports NotSupported on every desktop context (esextcDrawElementsBaseVertexTests.cpp, DrawElementsBaseVertexNegativeActiveTransformFeedbackTest).
ASTC formats need GL_KHR_texture_compression_astc_ldr, which is not advertised.
Stencil texturing needs GL 4.3 (GL_ARB_stencil_texturing is not advertised).
The case runs only on OpenGL 4.1 or newer contexts.

The case pairs a texture target with an access routine or format that the test marks invalid (gl3cTextureSwizzleTests.cpp isTargetSuppByAccess/isTargetSuppByFormat, or a format whose m_minimum_gl_context is above 3.3), so it reports NotSupported on every implementation.
Below a GL 3.3 context the case needs GL_ARB_sample_shading (glcFragCoordConventionsTests.cpp), which is not advertised; KHR-GL33 runs it.

KHR-GL31 creates a forward-compatible 3.1 context, and glu::contextSupports (gluRenderContext.cpp) matches a forward-compatible context only against its exact version, so the case's check for a GL 3.0 context fails (glcClipDistance.cpp); KHR-GL30, KHR-GL32 and KHR-GL33 run it.
